portal-display: Choose a screen in the system picker
portal-window: Choose a window in the system picker
preparing: Choose and allow your source in the system dialog…
silent: Video only · microphone is not recorded in this phase
shortcuts: Ctrl+Shift+8  Record / stop     Ctrl+Shift+9  Pause / resume
shortcuts-failed: Global shortcuts are unavailable. Full-screen recording requires shortcut permission to hide the controls safely.
hidden-bar: Controls hide while recording this screen. Use the global shortcuts to pause or stop.
wayland-zoom: This source includes the system cursor. Click events are unavailable, so click-based zoom is unavailable.
empty: Choose a source to start your next recording.
no-source: No sources available. Refresh or check screen sharing permissions.
wayland-dwell: Automatic zoom follows cursor pauses; global clicks are unavailable on this desktop.
shortcuts-ready: Global shortcuts are ready. Screen controls hide during recording.
